def record(name):
    with open('cleanup.txt', 'a') as out:
        out.write(name + '\n')
class Manager:
    def __init__(self, name, suppress=False):
        self.name = name
        self.suppress = suppress
    def __enter__(self):
        print('enter', self.name)
        return self
    def __exit__(self, kind, value, trace):
        print('exit', self.name, kind.__name__ if kind else '-')
        record(self.name)
        return self.suppress
record('start')
with Manager('outer'):
    for i in range(3):
        print('body', i)
        break
    print('after-loop')
print('done')

cases.name: suppression_then_continue
cases.source:
def record(name):
    with open('cleanup.txt', 'a') as out:
        out.write(name + '\n')
class Manager:
    def __init__(self, name, suppress=False):
        self.name = name
        self.suppress = suppress
    def __enter__(self):
        print('enter', self.name)
        return self
    def __exit__(self, kind, value, trace):
        print('exit', self.name, kind.__name__ if kind else '-')
        record(self.name)
        return self.suppress
record('start')
for i in range(2):
    with Manager(str(i), True):
        raise ValueError('suppressed')
    print('after', i)
    continue
print('done')
